verdict.rationale: Docs directly document deduplication by key (dedup key prevents duplicate alerts while one remains active) and alert grouping (related alerts grouped into one alert group for single triage/escalation/incident attach), which together deliver exactly the story of not paging fifty times for one issue. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of grouping accuracy at scale and configurability details beyond docs (e.g., custom grouping rules) aren't detailed.
